topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: Well now, I never did expect such a turn of events. There I was, scratching out my thoughts on the parchment, just as the scribe taught us, pouring all I had into those words. Just a lad from these parts, dreaming of places beyond the hills and the church’s bell. And lo, they took my words, my very thoughts, and set them out for others to see. They say it's an example, something to be looked upon by all. Folk from here and there will read what I penned, and perhaps they'll find a bit of truth in it, a bit of guidance. It seems my words have found their way into the wider world, just as I’ve always hoped I might.
